snippet.title: The Wrong Way - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Wrong Way - Official Trailer


WISHLIST ON STEAM  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5341070/The_Wrong_Way/


Available on itch.io
https://zestosyt.itch.io/the-wrong-way



THE WRONG WAY
"THE WRONG WAY" is a psychological horror game



BASED ON TRUE STORY


PLOT
It was supposed to be a simple camping trip. Two days in the woods with my closest friends. I had to leave early — work the next morning. So I drove back alone. That's when the GPS sent me the wrong way. The car broke down on a road I'd never seen before. No signal. No help. Just a motel I was never supposed to find.









GAMEPLAY
In The Wrong Way, you play as James — a regular guy on a weekend camping trip with his friends. What starts as a fun getaway slowly turns unsettling. When James leaves camp early and drives home alone, everything goes wrong. A dead car. An empty road. No signal. Explore campgrounds, dark roads, and quiet places where nothing feels quite right. Everyone you meet seems helpful. But nothing is what it seems. How far down the wrong road did you go — and can you find your way back?





Supports 8 languages
ENGLISH
SPANISH
ITALIAN
GERMAN
FRENCH
PORTUGUESE (BRAZIL)
TURKISH
RUSSIAN





Key Features
Atmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics.
VHS film aesthetic.
Receive texts from NPCs.
Talk to NPCs.
Player voice activity.


Controls WASD - Move

LMB - Interact

ESC - Chats menu

Left SHIFT - Move faster
